text:
jordan_c: FYI TapStone SI pinged—three marketplace leads they attempted to claim got blocked by SF intake rules. they can see the leads but claim button disabled.
nick_s: blocked how? missing partner mapping again or something else?
jordan_c: looks like two were missing Partner Account link, one had NDA flagged as 'pending'. TapStone said this is causing daily churn in their queue.
maya_ks: ouch. TapStone is Tier1 for us. they need faster claim windows. we should avoid manual AE rerouting if partner is active.
harper_m: ops note: our current intake guardrails require Partner_Account__c != NULL and NDA_Status__c = 'Signed' to enable claim. quick SF filter we can share: `RecordType = Lead AND LeadSource = 'Marketplace' AND (Partner_Account__c = NULL OR NDA_Status__c != 'Signed')`
lead-bot: system: added tag `si:needs-mapping` to affected leads, scheduled reminder to partner owners in 8h.
alina_pd: suggestion: SLA tiers by partner health score rather than static tier level? E.g., active Tier1 but low response score -> 48h not 24h. gives us flexibility.
nick_s: i like health-based windows but operationally heavier. can we do hybrid: Tier mapping default (24/48/72) but allow override to extend to 48 if partner response score < 60. document it in the marketplace partner playbook.
jordan_c: for quick unblock: can partnerships provide an AE handoff stub when routing back? something short AEs can paste into SF activity. example: `@SIOwner (TapStone): Please claim this lead within 24h. If unclaimed, AE will resume outreach. Contact partnerships@redwood.com for exceptions.`
harper_m: will add intake automation: (1) tag -> (2) partner reminder @ 8h -> (3) escalate to AE @ SLA expiry. will surface `si_claim_status` report in Console Ops.
lead-bot: system: created report `si_claim_status_v2` and shared with partnerships & ops.
maya_ks: parallel ask: when we do co-announcements with hardware partners referenced by SIs, we need marketplace Private Offer flag set before PR. last quarter a public listing went live before hardware partner signoff and caused confusion.
alina_pd: agree. add to joint-announcement checklist: `Marketplace listing = Private Offer (yes/no)`, `Marketplace go-live date`, `Partner PR contact`, `Hardware partner mention approved`. target alignment +-7 days for PR and listing.
nick_s: next steps: (1) harper to push tags & report by Thursday EOD (2) maya to draft AE handoff stub in playbook (3) jordan to confirm TapStone agrees to 24h pilot start on Monday (4) alina to update joint-announcement checklist and share with TapStone PM.
jordan_c: TapStone PM replied to my DM: ok to pilot Monday for 2 weeks, will measure claim latency + deal progression.
harper_m: i'll also add a small dashboard card for partner owners so they can see open market leads and 'claimable' status.
maya_ks: thanks team. small note: include Private Offer checkbox in the marketplace listing template so partners and AEs see it clearly.
lead-bot: system: will post a short follow-up in this thread when automation is live. :rocket:
